status: preregistration; no readout fitted on any arm's frame or feature
what_this_task_is: a perception/observation probe; trains no controller, collects no corpus, preregisters no control formulation
question: which change to the robot's observation at decision time makes the apple position and the expert's first reset-dependent command readable beyond the prior, with the TASK-059 probe unchanged

readouts.F2: RBF kernel, sigma^2 = median squared pairwise distance of training-part rows
readouts.T2_rule: sign of unclipped dx prediction; exact 0 counts as wrong
readouts.form: dual (kernel) ridge on n <= 171 training rows; identical for every source
readouts.preprocessing: float64; centre by training-part mean; no per-dimension scaling
readouts.selection: family and lambda per (source, target group, outer fold) by 5-fold inner CV on the outer training part minimizing MSE; inner folds default_rng(5900 + outer_fold).permutation(m) over the m outer-training rows in seed order, position mod 5; centring, sigma^2 and the lambda scale recomputed on each inner fit part
readouts.targets_centred: training-part mean is the intercept; T1 fitted jointly (2 outputs)

metrics.T1: median Euclidean error cm (mean reported); 95% percentile bootstrap over roots, 10000 resamples, default_rng(5901); paired bootstrap ratio to a baseline
metrics.T2: accuracy with Wilson 95% interval (caveat: OOF predictions from 10 models, independence approximate)
metrics.T3: MAE with bootstrap CI; paired bootstrap ratio to constant-median-dx MAE
metrics.bootstrap_indices: for a set of n roots default_rng(5901).integers(0, n, (10000, n)), drawn within the set (strata resampled within themselves), shared by every source and baseline on that set
metrics.strata: all; occluded (0 apple pixels at 112 px); visible (>= 1 pixel)
metrics.stratum_baseline_rule: all-roots out-of-fold prediction restricted to the stratum, except the occlusion-conditional mean (fitted within the stratum)

thresholds.T1_pass: median <= 1.5 cm AND upper 95% paired-bootstrap bound of median(source)/median(B_occ) <= 0.6
thresholds.T2_pass: accuracy >= 0.85 AND Wilson 95% lower > B_maj on the same roots
thresholds.beats_prior_on_stratum: Wilson lower of T2 > max(B_maj, B_y) on the stratum, OR upper bound of T1 ratio to B_occ < 1.0

justification.T1: 1.5 cm grasp tolerance (apple_policy_v1 2.2); B_mean 2.369 and B_occ 1.939 cm both fail it; ratio <= 0.6 makes the effective bar about 1.16 cm overall, 1.03 cm visible
justification.T2: B_maj 0.616; 0.85 removes >= 60% of prior errors; 162/190 has Wilson lower 0.795, 68/79 has 0.768
justification.T3: B_const MAE 0.314; a sign-perfect +-0.4 readout scores 0.040 (0.13x)

thresholds.random_floor_qualifier: E0/A3 beats the floor if the paired-bootstrap 95% CI of median T1 error (source - random) lies below 0 AND its T2 accuracy exceeds random's; else 'not attributable to pretraining'
thresholds.succeeds: T1 and T2 and T3 pass on the set of roots

baselines.B_maj: majority dx sign (= clock-only = proprio-only at step 0)
baselines.B_mean: predict the training-fold mean apple xy
baselines.B_occ: occlusion-conditional mean (privileged; the harder T1 bar)
baselines.B_rand: source iii, measured in the run
baselines.B_y: y-conditional dx-sign prior, 5 train-fold quantile bins of true apple y (privileged)

cohort.disclosure: TASK-057 D1-pipeline re-rendered 15 of the 20 val roots; they are val-split members, never a gating cohort

never_touched.test_split: never decoded (no frame, action or label read); DatasetStore.verify, reached via build_policy, reads episode bytes only to check sha256

cohort.roots: all 190 train+val roots of the frozen collection plan (170 train, 20 val), one reset frame each, aim-offset roots included; branch episodes excluded

split.fold_rule: roots sorted by seed; np.random.default_rng(59).permutation(190); fold = position mod 10 (19 per fold)
split.primary: grouped 10-fold CV over the 190 roots (one frame per root)
split.why_cv_is_primary: families and capacity fixed a priori with tuning nested in folds; n=20 val cannot carry a decision (19/20 has Wilson lower 0.764)

look_motion.sequence: the command repeated steps times, float32
look_motion.execution: collector step per command: clip to collect_apple_wide LOWER/UPPER, project_candidates, execute; observe before each command
look_motion.reset_independent: a constant; the executor receives only the robot
look_motion.selection_rule: per candidate, smallest k in 1..10 with every root visible (>=1 onboard 112 px segmentation pixel); smallest such k across candidates; ties by listed order
look_motion.selection_disclosure: candidates first explored in an uncommitted scratch script computing the same visibility table; rule written after seeing it; selection uses visibility only

H.why: 109/190 occluded at 224 px; T2 ceiling 0.768 overall

R.frame: onboard_rgb 448 px at reset, 4x4 box mean

E0.what: image_features of the frozen E0 encoder as arm A2 uses it

A3.what: image_features of arm A3's fine-tuned encoder

random.what: image_features of arm A1's frozen random-init encoder (same architecture, seed)

encoders.E0_input_contract: 112x112 RGB from onboard_rgb; decisional only in arm L

targets.T1: reset apple xy (world, m); the look does not move it
targets.T2: sign of the expert right_dx at the decision state (post-look for L, LH; reset for O, H, R, anchor)
targets.T3: the expert right_dx at the decision state, clipped to [-0.4, 0.4]
targets.T4_reported: right_dy; apple x alone; dx sign derived from T1 at the decision state
targets.expert_at_post_look: apple_collector_policy(reset truth) constructed fresh (orient phase, step 0), action(robot) at the post-look pose

baselines_arm_rules.B_occ_flag: TASK-059's: apple visibility in the 112 px onboard frame at reset (111 occluded), in every arm
baselines_arm_rules.B_occ_arm_reported: visibility-conditional mean with the arm's own flag; a training fold lacking the held root's flag falls back to B-mean

multiplicity.method: Holm step-down over the 4 decisional hypotheses, family-wise one-sided alpha 0.025
multiplicity.p_value: p_h = max(p_T1, p_T2, p_T3); p_T1 = share of the 10000 paired resamples with median ratio to B-occ > 0.6; p_T3 = share with MAE ratio to B-const > 0.6; p_T2 = 1 - Phi((acc - p0)/sqrt(p0(1-p0)/n)), p0 = B-maj on the same roots; p_h = 1 if median > 1.5 cm or accuracy < 0.85
pass_requires: render path validated in the run (section 5)
TASK-059 success on all 190 roots with unchanged bars (info_ceiling.evaluate succeeds)

spurious_check.ablation: apple geom moved to hidden group 5 (not drawn, no shadow); same out-of-fold readouts, each root predicted by the readout that held it out
spurious_check.spurious_if: hidden frames still beat the prior on all roots (TASK-059 definition)
spurious_check.renderer_must_reproduce_unablated_frame: byte-identical on every root, else the check is unavailable and the hypothesis does not pass

render_path_validation.role: not a void guard; a failure makes that arm non-decisional; the Holm family is not shrunk
render_path_validation.P0: 112 px onboard re-render at reset equals the stored frame (L)
render_path_validation.P1: frame equals an independent replica instance's frame after the same reset and look (L, LH, O)
render_path_validation.P2: PNG encode/decode round trip unchanged (L, LH, O)
render_path_validation.P3: 224 px instance joint state equals the 112 px instance's at reset and post-look (LH)

guards_void_the_run.G_hash: every file in hashes matches; episode files checked before decoding; encoder digests match; clean tree
guards_void_the_run.G_split: exactly the plan's 190 train+val seeds, splits agree with the dataset manifest; refuse test ids, cohort C, cohort D, seeds outside 48000-48199; fold hash matches
guards_void_the_run.G_render: 112 px re-render byte-identical on 190/190; reset proprio max std <= 1e-6
guards_void_the_run.G_expert: recomputed step-0 expert equals recorded label within 1e-6 on the 152 non-aim roots; apple label equals reset truth within 1e-6 m
guards_void_the_run.G_look: (a) executed sequence sha256 equals look_motion.sequence_sha256_float32_bytes; (b) in every instance applied == requested (max abs 0), identical across roots, no infeasible projection or rejection; (c) post-look joint state max abs spread across roots <= 1e-6; (d) apple xy and plate displacement during the look <= 1e-6 m, no hand-apple contact
guards_void_the_run.G_prior: reset-target baselines equal the TASK-059 manifest and post-look baselines equal calibration.values.prior_baselines.post_look_targets, within 1e-9 on every key
guards_void_the_run.not_guards: render-path validation (demotes an arm); the spurious check (blocks a pass)

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: a guard fails, or the run stops before writing a complete report (crash, wall cap)

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: a reset-independent look at the existing 112 px onboard camera makes apple and first command readable; E0 exposes them
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: corpus collection with the look prefix at 112 px onboard, prereg-gated; no control formulation until its own probe passes

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: the look makes the information present at 112 px; frozen E0 does not expose it
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: look-prefix corpus at 112 px, prereg-gated, plus separately preregistered encoder work

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: neither L hypothesis passes; LH-raw passes
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: clearing the wrist is necessary but not sufficient at 112 px; with more apple pixels it suffices
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: look-prefix corpus at a 224 px onboard camera, prereg-gated; needs an encoder at the new input size

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.condition: no look hypothesis passes; O-raw passes
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: a fixed scene camera reads the apple where the tested onboard views do not
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: corpus with the overview camera, prereg-gated; on the real robot a hardware/workspace design change (no scene camera on G1), stated as such

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.reading: no tested observation change makes apple position and first command readable with the frozen readouts at n=190
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.next: a hardware or camera design change, stated as such; no corpus collection on any tested observation

always_reported: every hypothesis's numbers, p-values, Holm steps and spurious check; every source on every stratum; secondary train->val; reported-only sources; which further rows also match; qualifiers 'unadjusted only; not a pass' and 'partial information'

void_rule.void: any stop before a complete report (guard, crash, wall cap) is V; nothing in it is read
void_rule.repeat: exactly one from-scratch repeat, same seeds, caps and device, clean tree, new directory run-2; any fix limited to runner mechanics via a reviewed PR and a fresh pre-run GO

superseded.note: earlier script versions; draft reported 3-D apple displacement, v1 lacked the hold control; every shared value identical except elapsed time

calibration.prior_baselines_disclosure: prior-only baselines need the expert's post-look command (a simulation fact); they read no observation and fit nothing, as in TASK-059

look_chosen.rule: smallest k with every root visible

process.reported_verdicts_only: A gated run starts only on the pre-run reviewer's REPORTED verdict, delivered as a message - never on a review file read from disk. Same rule for merging: only on the reviewer's reported APPROVE.
process.one_task_one_agent: One task, one agent. Do not launch a closeout/follow-up agent while the original task agent can still resume.
process.post_freeze_defects: escalated to the task owner; fixed only by disclosed amendment
